text:
Jamie: heads-up — we're seeing a rapid spike of 502/504s on hosted inference in eu-west for the /v1/generate endpoint, started ~30s ago. multiple CS tickets from a large tenant. creating this war room.
Sahil: on it, gathering gateway logs and k8s events. any customer repro yet?
Jen-CS: customer sent curl that times out after ~20s, they reported p95 latency jumps then 504s, customer id acme-inc. they said it started after a deploy ~45m ago.
Maria: looking at apigw logs — we’re getting a lot of upstream timeout: "connection reset by peer" and "read timeout" to runtime pods. not consistent across all pods.
Taylor: can you paste a sample error line?
Maria: ``ERROR apigw: upstream read timeout host=runtime-2 pod=runtime-2-7f8b df=eu-west path=/v1/generate status=504 latency=20012ms``
Lexi: early signal shows a spike in in-flight tokens per pod, KV cache miss rate jumped to 0.42 from baseline 0.05 when the surge hit. might be cache warmup + long sequences.
Sahil: where's the autoscaler? metrics show HPA CPU unchanged — looks like queueing at the runtime process level not container CPU. autoscaler isn't seeing the backlog.
Jamie: immediate mitigations?
Taylor: 1) flip routing to fallback smaller model for this customer only (reduce per-token time). 2) bump concurrency limit on their route. 3) disable canary rollout if recently deployed.
Jamie: do 1+2 now. Sahil, Lexi, coordinate.
Sahil: running route override for acme-inc -> model: redwood-llm-small-v1, sticky for 10m. applying: `rbctl routes patch --tenant acme-inc --set=runtime_model=redwood-llm-small-v1 --ttl=600`
deploy-bot: route override applied to tenant acme-inc by Sahil at 9998765450
Lexi: also enabling short-circuit caching for common prompt prefixes for acme-inc: `cachectl enable-prefix acme-inc --prefix="Summarize:" --ttl=120`
Jen-CS: letting acme support know, they reported initial drop in errors after fallback. sending customer note. :white_check_mark:
Maria: observed 50% drop in 5xx within 90s of fallback. p95 latency for acme requests down from 18s -> 2.1s.
Taylor: good. still want root cause — sequence length distribution for acme shows many >8k tokens in the last hour. runtime KV cache eviction rate also spiked. probably model working set + eviction thrash.
Sahil: reproduction steps from our side to validate: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-Tenant: acme-inc" -d '{"input":"<very long doc...>"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
We can run in a loop with different seq lengths.
Jamie: postmortem actions we should capture now (assign owners):
- increase default KV cache size for eu-west runtime pools (owner: Lexi)
- add a per-tenant circuit to auto-fallback to smaller model if p99 latency > 10s for 2m (owner: Taylor)
- improve autoscaler signals to include runtime queue depth / token backlog (owner: Sahil)
- add test / replay harness to simulate long-seq customer bursts (owner: Maria + Eng-ML)
- customer comms + SLA note for acme (owner: Jen-CS)
Lexi: noted. will start config PR for KV sizing and add monitoring dashboard. ETA 48h.
Taylor: I'll draft the circuit + rollout plan. want canary config for tenant-scoped fallback.
Sahil: autoscaler change needs runtime metric export first — I'll open infra ticket and prototype exporter. ETA 72h.
Maria: I'll add regression test for sequences >8k in our nightly replay pipeline.
Jen-CS: I'll send a short customer update now, follow-up with a postmortem email once we have root cause.
Jamie: one more quick low-effort fix — temporarily increase keepalive on runtime side to reduce connection churn while we stabilize. Sahil want to toggle?
Sahil: doing `kubectl patch deployment runtime --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"runtime","env":[{"name":"KEEPALIVE_MS","value":"90000"}]}}]}}}'` now.
deploy-bot: deployment/runtime patched by Sahil at 9998765520
Lexi: monitoring shows drop in connection resets after keepalive bump. still watching KV eviction rate.
Jamie: excellent. capture key timestamps and metrics for postmortem. I’ll schedule a 1hr follow-up retro in #postmortems in 24h.
Taylor: assigning action items in the incident board now.
Jen-CS: customer acme confirmed reduced errors and appreciated fast fallback. closing their support thread pending postmortem.
Sahil: closing war room — will leave follow-up thread notes here. if anything regresses ping me. :rocket:
